finding.reason: At the inside probe (0.125,0.125), distance is NaN. std::max(finiteAccumulator, NaN) returns finiteAccumulator because finiteAccumulator < NaN is false. NaN is never stored in the finite planar cell poles. Remaining finite probes are consistent with the plane. The BSplineSurface constructor therefore cannot detect this discarded NaN.
